_comment: Exact-text rewrites that remove weak absolute language (always/never/illegal) from approved question options and stems while preserving each option's truth value (distractors stay wrong; the single correct option that read 'No, never' stays a correct 'No'). Applied DB-wide by scripts/apply-weak-distractor-rewrites.mjs. Targets are reused from the repo seed fixes for consistency.

options.Accept that further detention is always: Accept that further detention is routinely available on request.
options.Advise that magistrates always grant war: Advise that magistrates grant warrants automatically.
options.Always disclose every prior conviction i: Voluntarily disclose every prior conviction in interview.
Refuse any interpreter as a matter of routine.
Refuse to let them turn away.
options.Always requires a court order: Requires a Crown Court order in every case
options.Arrest is always necessary for investiga: Arrest is necessary for any investigation
Autism does not trigger AA requirements.
options.Bad character is always admissible in in: Bad character is freely admissible in interview.
options.Both always require consent: Both require consent in every case
Client wishes override DSCC attendance rules.
Crown Court deals with it first.
options.It can never be delayed: It cannot be delayed in any circumstances
options.It does not matter because arrest is alw: It does not matter because arrest is lawful once the client is in custody.
options.It is always kept until release: It is kept until release in every case
It is lawful to continue regardless of the evidence.
options.It should always be removed: It should be removed in every case
options.Known suspects are always charged: Known suspects are charged in every case
options.Never - Threshold Test is final: Not required - the Threshold Test is final
options.Never - a caution must always be given b: Not at all - a caution must be given before any questioning
options.Never - always detain at the station fir: Not appropriate - detain at the station first in every case
options.Never - consent is always required: Not without consent - consent is required in every case
options.Never - it is not used: Not at all - it is not used
options.Never - it is not useful: Not at all - it is not useful
options.Never - legal advice is mandatory: Not permitted - legal advice is mandatory
options.Never - records are not provided: Not at all - records are not provided
options.Never - the right to silence is absolute: In no circumstances - the right to silence is absolute
options.Never - they have an absolute right to r: In no circumstances - they have an absolute right to remain
options.Never - they must always authorize if re: In no circumstances - they must authorize if requested
options.Never - they must remain silent: In no circumstances - they must remain silent
options.Never - vehicles need a separate warrant: Not under this warrant - vehicles need a separate warrant
options.Never if the witness is certain: Not where the witness is certain
options.Never while in custody: Not at any point while in custody
There is no need to confirm; it is irrelevant.
options.No, they can never be excluded: No, they cannot be excluded in any circumstances
Nothing; attendance is mandatory regardless of detail.
A bruise does not count as ABH.
options.Police must always use force: Police must use force in every case
options.Promise silence can never be used agains: Promise silence will not be used against them.
Promise them they will not be charged.
options.Refusal to give details is always an obs: Refusal to give details is an obstruction offence in itself.
options.Refuse all sampling; consent is always r: Refuse all sampling; consent is required for any sample.
options.Say immigration never follows criminal c: Say immigration consequences do not follow criminal cases.
options.Sensitive material never needs to be dis: Sensitive material does not need to be disclosed
Silence cannot be mentioned at trial.
Street ID is the preferred option here.
Telephone advice is not permitted here.
options.Tell them denial is always perjury later: Tell them denial amounts to perjury later.
options.Tell them immigration never follows arre: Tell them immigration consequences do not follow arrest.
Tell them juries do not hear about silence.
Tell them to withhold consent in all circumstances.
options.The officer is correct: prepared stateme: The officer is correct: prepared statements are not permitted under PACE.
options.The search is always valid with any empl: The search is valid with any employee's consent
options.They are always retained: They are retained in every case
options.To always grant unconditional bail: To grant unconditional bail in every case
options.Visual recording should always be used: Visual recording should be used in every case
Written notes alone are adequate here.
